The PM has direct responsibility for the overall operation of the Birdsboro plant. This position is responsible for the Birdsboro sites Replacement Asset Value (RAV) of approximately $120 million (original purchase cost of approximately $65 million), Replacement Plant Earnings (RPE) of approximately $12 million, annual variable costs exceeding $75 million (including monomers), and annual CAPEX of $4-5 million.

This positio

The PM has full P/L responsibility and provides leadership, direction, and management for all aspects of the plant’s manufacturing operations. The PM assists in the creation of the organization’s vision and growth strategies and executes the business and operations plans to achieve revenue, profit, and performance targets while continuing the plant’s record of success and high levels of safety and customer service.. 
 
The Plant Manager directly supports Plant Staff to manage activities and lead continued improvement in the areas of Operations, Maintenance, Human Resources, Engineering, Accoun

ff to manage activities and lead continued improvement in the areas of Operations, Maintenance, Human Resources, Engineering, Accounting, Purchasing, Quality, and Laboratories. The PM possesses a strong, working knowledge of and ensures compliance with; external regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and internal policies and procedures (specifically capital, accounting, purchasing, and HES).

Safety and Environment – 20% 
HSE responsibilities include but are not restricted to those outlined in Leadership expectations suc

w safe and efficient operation. Ensures that the plant produces at volumes to meet demand requirements set forth in S&OP plans. Ensures that adequate training is provided for a safe and efficient plant operations.

postingQuotes: Senior Director, Commercial Manufacturing and Operations
The Senior Director, Commercial Manufacturing & Operations is Olema’s senior leader accountable for building, scaling and governing the commercial manufacturing and supply platform for palazestrant.

Provide business and operational oversight of commercial DS and DP manufacturing, partnering with CMC Technical, Quality and Regulatory on registrational readiness, PPQ, process validation and the transition to commercial supply.
Coordinate batch disposition with Quality and the release of finished goods to the 3PL.

We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028.
Commercial Supply Strategy & Launch Readiness

We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028.

We recently presented encouraging Phase 1 monotherapy data from this program across multiple solid tumor types, are advancing patient enrollment in the ongoing combination arms in MBC, and expect to initiate a Phase 1 study of OP-3136 in combination with Bayer’s darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer by the end of this year.
Strategic and hands-on: shapes the commercial supply platform and does the daily work a lean, build-from-scratch organization requires.

**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team member

* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
